CARRY_OVER_NOT_REVIEWED: {count} unfinished commitments still need a carry-over decision before {quarter} can close.
COMMIT_GATE_FOOTPRINT_REQUIRED: A commitment needs at least one capacity footprint before it can be committed. Place it on a team and quarter, then commit.
COMMIT_GATE_PRIMARY_FOOTPRINT_MISMATCH: The primary team needs its own capacity footprint. Add one for {team}, or change the primary team.
COMMIT_GATE_PRIMARY_TEAM_REQUIRED: A commitment needs a primary team before it can be committed. Choose a primary team, then commit.
DUPLICATE_FOOTPRINT: {name} already has a footprint on {team} in {quarter}. Edit that one instead.
ENTITY_ARCHIVED: {name} is archived. Restore it before changing it.
ENTITY_HAS_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT: {name} has an unresolved sync conflict. Choose keep mine, take theirs, or edit a merged value before changing it again.
ENTITY_NOT_FOUND: That item no longer exists. It may have been removed by someone else.
FOOTPRINT_UNITS_MUST_BE_POSITIVE: A footprint needs more than zero units. To remove the load, remove the footprint.
ILLEGAL_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION: A commitment cannot move from {from} to {to}.
IMPORT_INVALID_ENUM_VALUE: Row {row}: '{value}' is not a valid {field}. Map it in the value table.
IMPORT_MISSING_EXTERNAL_KEY: Row {row} has no external key, so it will create a new record rather than update an existing one.
IMPORT_UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: Row {row} refers to {reference}, which is not in this file or this workspace.
INVALID_VALUE: That is not one of the available options.
MANDATORY_TARGET_DATE_REQUIRED: Mandatory work needs a target date before it can be committed.
MIGRATION_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Migration {version} has changed since it was applied. This build cannot safely open the workspace.
MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_IMPACTS: A commitment can have only one primary product or service. {existing} is already primary.
NOTE_TOO_LONG: Notes are limited to {max} characters. This one is {actual}.
QUARTER_CLOSED: {quarter} is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
RDY_LOW_CONFIDENCE_LARGE: This is large and the size is low confidence — worth a second look before it takes a quarter.
RDY_NO_DEPENDENCIES_REVIEWED: Nobody has confirmed the dependencies were looked at.
RDY_NO_OUTCOME: No outcome is stated, so nobody can tell later whether it worked.
RDY_NO_OWNER: Nobody is named as accountable for this.
RDY_NO_PRODUCT_IMPACT: No product or service is named as affected.
RDY_NO_TARGET: There is no target quarter or date.
RDY_SPANS_MANY_QUARTERS: This spans more than three quarters, which usually means it is more than one piece of work.
RESERVES_EXCEED_CAPACITY: Reserves total {reserved} units but {team} has {capacity} in {quarter}. Lower a reserve or raise the capacity adjustment.
RESERVE_IS_SYSTEM_MANAGED: Held capacity is managed by Flowmap. Resume {name} to release it.
SCENARIO_CANNOT_MUTATE_BASELINE: Scenario changes cannot alter the baseline. Apply the scenario instead.
SCENARIO_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED: {command} cannot be done inside a scenario.
SCENARIO_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED: {count} conflicts need a decision before this scenario can be applied.
SCENARIO_SELECTION_INCOMPLETE: {count} selected changes depend on changes you have not selected. Include them to continue.
SCENARIO_STALE: The baseline has changed since this scenario was created. Rebase it before applying.
SCHEMA_VERSION_TOO_NEW: This workspace was saved by a newer version of Flowmap. Update to version {required} or later to open it.
SELF_DEPENDENCY: A commitment cannot depend on itself.
SPLIT_UNITS_MISMATCH: A split must keep the same total. The parts add up to {actual}, not {expected}.
STALE_VERSION: Someone else changed {name} while you were editing. Review their change, then try again.
TEAM_HAS_ACTIVE_FOOTPRINTS: {team} still has committed work. Move or remove its footprints before archiving it.
TOO_MANY_MILESTONES: A commitment can have up to {max} milestones.
UNAUTHORISED: You do not have permission to do this. Ask a Planner to make this change.
WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: That workspace could not be found.
XL_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_UNITS: XL has no default size. Enter the capacity units for this footprint.
REFINEMENT_LINK_NOT_PERMITTED: Only a refinement reserve can support an Idea, and only while the work is still an Idea.
